notes.title: Love Menu" Update: New Minigame and Enhancements!
notes.notes:
Dear "Love Menu" Community, ✨🎉

We are thrilled to announce several updates to "Love Menu" that we believe will enhance your gameplay and overall experience. Here's a rundown of what you can expect:

New Erotic Minigame Animation: We are excited to introduce a new high-quality animation to the game. While this does not replace any existing animations just yet, it's the first of many steps towards phasing out the simpler early-access animations. Our goal is to continually improve the quality and immersion of our animations, so stay tuned for more additions in the future!

New Minigame:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43392423/6ae91b2ceeb2b9d918557a72e9cc70e16f0af5cf.pngThe restaurant is bustling and Lilly could use a hand! She needs your help in the kitchen. Are you up for the task? And remember, a steamy reward awaits for you. Roll up your sleeves and prepare for an exciting culinary adventure!

Art Resolution Fixes: We've addressed some issues with the resolution of various art pieces that were displayed incorrectly. You'll now be able to enjoy our beautiful artwork as intended.

Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements: We've made several tweaks and fixes to improve gameplay and make your experience smoother and more enjoyable.

Sound Effect and Music Corrections: We've made several adjustments to the game's sound effects and music to enhance your immersion in the world of "Love Menu".

Minor Story Adjustments: We've made some slight changes to the story to improve your gameplay experience.

Love Menu needs your review! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We've been working hard to improve "Love Menu" and we hope you enjoy these new updates! However, we desperately need your support. If you're enjoying the game, we humbly ask that you consider leaving a review on Steam. ❤️

Your reviews are crucial in helping new players discover our game and also provide us with invaluable feedback so we can continue to enhance and expand "Love Menu". By leaving a review, you are directly supporting small developers like us and enabling us to continue doing what we love.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43392423/d327fe36fd601726d9c85db1dfdb52ea3df78bc8.png
We understand that writing reviews takes time, but your efforts make a world of difference to us.
Thank you for being part of our community and for your continued support.

notes.title: Update coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello Love Menu players! We are excited to announce that a new update is coming your way soon. As always, we appreciate your continued support and feedback.

For those of you who love to report bugs and want to test out new features in advance, you can access the beta build (Experimental) to get a sneak peek at the changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43392423/a62119b058d2dae06e1ff8a3cdafb096869d871f.png

So, what's included in this update? We've got some exciting things to share with you:


 New Minigame - Get ready to step into the kitchen and help prepare some delicious dishes! This new minigame is sure to be a fun addition to Love Menu and we can't wait for you to try it out.
 Introduction of the Main Character.
 New Animation Added to Erotic Minigame - Our goal is to continue improving the quality of the animations in Love Menu, and we're working hard to replace the older animations with new, high-quality ones. Stay tuned for more updates, as we have more animations in the works and can't wait to share them with you!
 Bug Fixes - We've also addressed some minor bugs in this update to improve your overall gameplay experience.


As always, we appreciate your support and encourage you to leave a review for Love Menu. It means the world to us as small indie developers.

Thank you for playing Love Menu and we can't wait to see what you think of the new update!

notes.title: Pool minigame hotfix 2
notes.notes: Another hotfix is now available, fixing the issue with the pool minigame. We are still investigating. We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Hotfix - [Help Her] (Pool Minigame)
notes.notes:
We have fixed the issue causing a black screen when attempting to enter the pool minigame. You should now be able to access the game without any problems. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
If the update doesn't appear for you, please restart Steam.
